question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words

Anything pertaining to cats
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Bovine"** pertains to cattle or oxen. (गाय या बैल से संबंधित)

 
 
• **Example: **The farmer took care of his bovine herd with great dedication.
 
 
 
• **"Feline"** pertains to cats. (बिल्ली से संबंधित)
 
 
• **Example: **The feline grace of the cat made it a favorite among the pet lovers.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Canine** (कुत्ते से संबंधित): Pertaining to dogs.

 
 
• **Example:** The canine unit of the police force is highly trained.
 
 
 
• **Taurine** (बैल से संबंधित): Pertaining to bulls.
 
 
• **Example:** The taurine energy drink is believed to boost physical performance.
